english.title: Failure of licence holder to produce operating licence to constable / enforcement officer - Gambling Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of an operating licence issued under section 65(1) of the Gambling Act 2005, failed without reasonable excuse to produce it after having been required by

(A)_[a constable]_
(B)_[an enforcement officer]_

to do so within a specified period, namely **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 108 of the Gambling Act 2005.
